markers.reading: Seeker, Kenzo, and Wellby emerge from the falls and reunite with Delwath and Riswynn on November 15 at sunset.

time.basis: November 15 is spoken in the opening; sunset is confirmed in Kenzo’s description; the year is inherited from YAML.

evidence.quote: DM: Until on November fifteenth— so, nearly 3 months since you last saw Riswynn, and a month and a half or so, 2 months since you last saw each other— you see emerging out of the waterfall your friends: Seeker, Kenzo and Wellby.
DM: Yeah, that sunset. You can only pass through Lastlight Falls at sunset each day.

markers.reading: The party switches to Seeker’s telepathic link, completing the ten-minute ritual casting.

duration.basis: The DM specifies ten minutes to ritual-cast; Seeker accepts the completed action with “Cool done.”

evidence.quote: Seeker: We switch over to that. Yes.

DM: It just means if you take 10 min to cast it instead of an action, you don't need to spend the spell slot. Okay.

Seeker: Cool done.

yamlCheck.dateAnchor: The reunion is explicitly November 15; sunset is independently confirmed. The year 1748 comes from YAML. Recounted solo adventures and dated scryings are background accounts, not earlier scenes played out in this session.
yamlCheck.explanation: Play remains at the reunion camp on the same evening, with a completed ten-minute ritual and no narrated overnight or departure. The DM’s “half midnight now” and “seventeenth” concern the real-world session closing and next meeting, not the fictional calendar.
